paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a traveling wave parametric amplifier
notes: QUAX-agamma haloscope with TWPA at 10.353 GHz. Sets upper limit g_agamma < 2.05e-14 GeV^-1 (90% single-sided CL, power-constrained) over axion mass range 42.8178-42.8190 ueV. Figure 7 shows a series of blue bars spanning this narrow range near ~2e-14 GeV^-1; only the minimum value is given numerically in text, so data_points span the stated mass range at the minimum limit value.
